We need to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014). We have four vendors: Acme, Orbital, BrightPath, Nimbus. We need to compare total delivered price, lead time, warranty. Then find cheapest vendor. Then search web for recent reviews of that vendor and summarise them. End with line 'Best price: <vendor>'.

We have data for each vendor:

Acme: unit 742, subtotal 37,100, shipping 450, total 37,550. Lead time 14 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

Orbital: unit 760, list total 38,000, volume discount 4% for orders over 40 units, total delivered 36,480. Shipping included. Lead time 10 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

BrightPath: unit 715, total delivered 35,750. Shipping 0. Lead time 21 calendar days. Warranty 2 years on-site.

Nimbus: unit 728, total 36,700. Shipping 300. Lead time 7 business days. Warranty 3 years on-site.

So cheapest total delivered price is BrightPath 35,750. Next Orbital 36,480. Nimbus 36,700. Acme 37,550.

Thus cheapest vendor is BrightPath Systems.

Now we need to search web for recent reviews of BrightPath Systems. Use search_web tool.
